snippet.title: Faraday Blues - XBOX Tokyo Game Show - Official Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Rewrite the past. Simulate the future. Discover who you really are.

Faraday Blues is a surreal sci-fi visual novel and strategy card game where every choice, every card, and every ending reshapes reality. Play across three interconnected stories and uncover many endings, each bringing you closer to the truth.

Faraday Blues is available to wishlist today ahead of its launch on XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC. It will also have full support for XBOX Cloud and XBOX Play Anywhere.

https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9NX6KM512V3K
